simple.meaning: wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed)

definitions.short: wormwood (regarded as poisonous, and therefore accursed)
definitions.full: H3939. laanah לַעֲנָה noun feminine wormwood (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic is curse (verb id. ), so Nabataean לצנת (verb לען ) compare Cook Glossary ); — only figurative of bitter things: — of perverted justice, Amos 5:7 ; 6:12 (|| ראֹשׁ ; of result of idolatry, Deut 29:17 (|| id. ); of ׳י s chastisement Jer 9:14 (|| מֵ֯ירֿאֹשׁ , 23:15 (|| id. ), Lam 3:15 (|| מְרוֺרִים ), 3:19 (|| ראֹשׁ ); simile of bitter ( מָרָה ) result of intercourse with strange woman Prov 5:4 . — On wormwood (Artemisia absinthium , etc., Greek ἀψίθιον ) compare Löw 80f. 401, 421 Tristr Nat, Hist. Bib. 493 . לָעַע see לוע לפד (√ of following; meaning unknown).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root supposed to mean to curse;
